purpose: Extend cross-node reproduction coverage from the single preregistered factorial development panel to confirmation panels and to the headline official-16K BABILong panel, on a GPU of a different architecture from every retained run, so that prediction-level reproduction can be reported independently of bit-level identity.

hardware.reference_runs: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (compute capability 12.0), three separately provisioned instances; see reports/NODE_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE_2026-09-20.json
hardware.rerun: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (Ampere, compute capability 8.0), Vast.ai instance, hostname 067dc8350c5b, GPU UUID GPU-5b892f6f-ac8e-8c99-71ed-7efad31c6765, serial 1652523038517, driver 580.159.03
hardware.rule: Exactly one machine is used. No matched-architecture machine is sought, and no second machine is used to retry any cell. Selecting hardware until a comparison passes is the same class of error as selecting seeds.

software_parity.note: identical pinned versions to reproduction/environment.json; the only intended difference from the reference runs is the GPU architecture

runner_code.commit_rule: the runs execute from a clean git worktree at the commit that contains this file; environment_before.json and environment_after.json must both record git_dirty=false and the same commit

experiments/run_babilong_prompt.py.change: adds --audit-label so that new audit records carry a descriptive status instead of the legacy 'posthoc_code_audit_correction_rerun_no_independence_claim' constant; the computation path is untouched (see git diff 98462d9..HEAD -- experiments/run_babilong_prompt.py)

cells.selection_rule: the lowest-numbered confirmation panel of the numeric factorial (panel 1 is the development panel already covered by the retained node1/node2 pair)
the next confirmation panel in numeric order, run because the budget allows a second panel
the lowest-numbered confirmation panel of the official-16K family; the same panel for all three readers so the co-scaled diagonal on one panel is reproduced end to end

ladder: 1_discrete: per-row identity of every discrete scientific field (answers, generated strings, scores, argmax candidates, retained facts, state bytes, prompt-token counts) and of every top-level scientific field; reported as the number of differing rows per field
2_continuous: per-row max absolute and max relative difference over every stored NLL and probability value, reported as numbers
3_panel_precision: whether each panel statistic prints identically at manuscript precision (accuracies 4 decimals, NLL nats 3 decimals), with raw values from both sides
4_binary64: whether every stored float is IEEE-754 binary64 identical

expectations_stated_in_advance.1_discrete: expected to hold for BABILong (greedy decoding, discrete outputs) and for factorial argmax candidates; any row that differs is a finding and is reported with its row_id
expectations_stated_in_advance.2_continuous: last-bit differences expected across architectures; magnitudes are reported, not judged
expectations_stated_in_advance.3_panel_precision: the scientifically meaningful test: whether the numbers printed in the paper survive a different operator implementation
expectations_stated_in_advance.4_binary64: may fail across architectures; failure here is an expected consequence of differing tensor-core and reduction paths and is not described as a reproduction failure

interpretation_rules.all_levels_hold: report architecture-independent prediction-level and bit-level reproduction for the named cells
interpretation_rules.levels_1_and_3_hold_level_4_fails: report architecture-independent reproduction of every prediction, scientific field and printed statistic; keep the bit-identity claim scoped to the retained matched-architecture node pair (development panel 1); state the max abs/rel differences
interpretation_rules.level_1_fails_for_some_rows: report exactly how many rows differ per cell and by how much every panel statistic moves; the manuscript reproducibility section states this; no cell is rerun, no other hardware is used, and no seed, batch size, dtype or setting is changed
interpretation_rules.a_run_aborts: the log is kept under artifacts_revision/crossnode_2026-09/logs/, the abort is recorded in docs/EXPERIMENT_LEDGER.md, and it is disclosed; the cell is not silently re-executed with different settings
interpretation_rules.no_number_in_the_manuscript_may_be_repla: reference records remain the reported values regardless of outcome; the rerun is audit evidence only and is labelled no_independence_claim

manuscript_wording_bound_to_outcome.cross_node_coverage_sentence_template: Cross-instance reruns now cover: the factorial development panel (matched architecture, binary64-identical), factorial confirmation panels 2 and 3 for Qwen2.5-7B/K=5 (different architecture, <outcome>), official-16K confirmation panel 1 for Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B in both arms (different architecture, <outcome>), official-16K panel 1 for Qwen2.5-7B (matched architecture, identical), and all ten official-16K panels for Qwen3-8B (third instance, identical). Every other experimental cell was run once.
never_write: bit-exact for the A100 rerun unless level 4 holds
independent replication for any post-hoc audit rerun
physical node without the GPU-identity table
